title: Transcriptome analysis of luminal and basal cell subpopulations in the lactating versus pregnant mammary gland
assay_types: Expression profiling by high throughput sequencing
decision: Twelve libraries cover two cell populations and three stages. Limit the first baseline to a prespecified replicated contrast, then add an interaction-aware adapter. Do not pool stages.

rights.reason: GEO public access does not establish unrestricted redistribution permission. Source-specific review remains open.

scorecard_note: Unreviewed fields remain null. A number would imply sample-level review that has not occurred.
